messages:
amy (sales): Heads up — Observa wants a 30d POC next week and sent a SIG/CAIQ + vendor questionnaire. Can eng-security triage asap?

maria (eng-security): Uploading docs to our queue. Does POC use real customer data or sanitized logs?

amy (sales): Only redacted logs and metadata, no PII. We've requested a data-minimization addendum.

kyle (solutions): Tech scope: API access + one S3 prefix. No inbound peering required. We'll need an IP allowlist for test runners.

maria (eng-security): Initial flags: no SOC2 attached, unclear KMS/customer-managed key support, retention policies missing.

devsec-bot: Scan result: missing SOC2, pen-test summary present, KMS policy absent.

amy (sales): Asked vendor for SOC2 timeline, KMS diagram, pen-test details, and CMK support. Said SOC2 ETA 6w.

maria (eng-security): For a POC OK with restrictions. Requirements: synthetic-only data, TTL <=30d, scoped read-only API key with rotation <24h, audit log access, review pen-test.

kyle (solutions): I'll prepare S3 prefix and IAM role. Example policy: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc/observa/*

oliver (legal): We can allow POC while SOC2 pending if NDA + POC addendum limit scope and include right-to-audit and suspension clause. Send NDA for redline.

devsec-bot: Pen-test findings: mostly low; one medium (service account credentials long TTL). Vendor committed to remediate in 7 days.

maria (eng-security): Vendor uses AWS-managed KMS, no CMK. They offered daily key rotation and SIEM-forwarded audit logs as mitigation.

amy (sales): Vendor can provide warmup endpoint for latency tests and will rotate keys daily.

maria (eng-security): Approving POC under conditions above. I'll draft a short security addendum with the controls.

oliver (legal): I'll prepare NDA + addendum on DocuSign today.

amy (sales): Thanks all — aiming to start next week once docs are signed. We'll block production use until SOC2/CMK reassessed.
